parent_skeleton:
# invoke(read_memory, args)

Bridge skill — delegates to the built-in tool in `system_tools/invoke(read_memory, args).py`.

read_memory.name: read_memory
read_memory.description: Read a memory value by key, or list all available keys if no key is provided.

memory_key.description: Key to read. Omit to list all available keys.

result.description: The memory value associated with the given key, or a list of available keys when memory_key is omitted.

postconditions: requested memory value or key listing is returned

error_conditions.output_shape: error message indicating the key does not exist
error_conditions.recovery_hint: Verify the key name, or omit memory_key to list all available keys.

error_conditions.output_shape: error indicating system_tools/read_memory.py could not be loaded
error_conditions.recovery_hint: Ensure the system_tools package is installed and accessible.
